body.x: Optrix(www.optrix.com) showcased ‘PhotoProX’ waterproof, drop proof iPhone 5 & 5S camera case with 4 interchangeable lenses at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
Optrix PhotoProX is waterproof, drop proof iPhone 5 & 5S camera housing with 4 interchangeable lenses.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
